missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Обезьяна' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'сидит'. 'Маленькая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'на дереве' is the prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Обезьяну' is the accusative direct object of 'увидели'. As an animate feminine noun it takes the -у ending in the accusative.

missions.phrase: У этой обезьяны очень длинный хвост.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Обезьяны' is genitive in the 'у' frame, showing whose tail it is. The feminine genitive singular ending is -ы here.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Обезьяне' is the dative recipient, while 'банан' is the accusative object of 'дала'. The feminine dative ending is -е.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'С обезьяной' uses the instrumental form 'обезьяной' after 'с' to mean together with the animal. The feminine instrumental ending is -ой.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об обезьяне' uses the prepositional form 'обезьяне' after 'об' to express the topic of the book. The feminine ending shifts to -е.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Обезьяны' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'прыгают'. 'Весёлые' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'в клетке' is the prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural of absence. 'Обезьян' is the genitive plural after 'нет', expressing that there are none. The feminine plural drops the vowel ending entirely.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Обезьян' is the accusative plural object of 'кормит'. For animate nouns the accusative plural matches the genitive plural form.

missions.phrase: Эта обезьяна очень умная и быстрая.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Обезьяна' is nominative as the subject. 'Умная' and 'быстрая' are agreeing feminine adjectives describing it, joined by 'и'.
